# Prompt library management

**One file per prompt, versioned and scored, indexed offline — plus 12 ready Claudia prompts to start from.**

Organises an AI character's prompts as a versioned, searchable library — folder layout, one Markdown file per prompt with YAML front matter (id, version, status, model, params, refs, seed, scores, cost, output hashes, retirement date), naming and tagging by pillar/scene/model, identity-block versioning (CLAUDIA ID v2 → v2), A/B logs, and deprecating prompts when models retire (Veo 3.1 previews 2026-10-22, GPT Image 1.5 2026-12-01, ElevenLabs premade voices 2026-12-31, OpenAI TTS 2027-01-06). Ships an offline indexer script and a seed library of 12 complete Claudia prompts (studio talk, the club, visor reveal, club flash selfie, blue render, sky gown, silver night, holo on cobalt, silver-foil banner, platform banner, looks collage, official portrait). Use when saving a prompt that worked, finding one to reuse, migrating to a new model, or setting up a library for a new character.

## Install

```sh
# Claude Code (all projects on this machine)
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
curl -fsSLo /tmp/prompt-library-management.zip https://useclaudia.xyz/skills/prompt-library-management.zip
unzip -oq /tmp/prompt-library-management.zip -d ~/.claude/skills

# Codex and other agents that read ~/.agents/skills
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && unzip -oq /tmp/prompt-library-management.zip -d ~/.agents/skills
```

Or straight from GitHub with the [`skills` CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):
`npx skills add claudia-onchain/Claudia-Skills --skill prompt-library-management`.

In the Claude apps: **Customize → Skills → + → Upload a skill**, and pick `prompt-library-management.zip` (don't unzip it).
More apps: [install a skill](../../../README.md#install-a-skill).

Then ask for the task in your own words, or call it directly with `/prompt-library-management`.
